Looping in the sim results; I ran three quick scenarios in the spreadsheet (attached). Highlights here so Lisa's team can scan quickly: 

1) Baseline (open-gpt-7b q4_0; batch window 20ms; cache hit 30%)
   - Avg tokens per session: 460 (120 in / 340 out)
   - Effective throughput: ~18.2K tokens/sec per GPU (amortized with batching)
   - Cost: $0.00095 per 1K tokens (hosted price proxy for the POC) -> ~1,213K effective tokens per $

2) Low cache (0% hit) & small batch window (5ms)
   - Throughput down ~22%; per-token execution overhead higher; cost -> $0.00125 per 1K tokens
   - Observed tokens/$ drop to ~800K tokens per $1

3) High cache (60% hit) & larger batching (100ms)
   - Effective tokens/$ improves to ~1.9M tokens per $1 (cache avoids repeated prompt decoding; batching drives GPU utilization)

Notes/assumptions & caveats:
- The per-1K-token cost above uses a hosted inference benchmark (includes runtime + inter-region network egress assumptions). If CardioNova uses Dedicated or Private, unit price and latency profile will differ — we'll add those variants in the xlsx.
- Prefix caching benefits depend on how much of the prompt is reused. If your workflows reuse patient context across multiple calls (recommended), we should see >40% effective savings.
- We modeled KV cache memory pressure as negligible for the POC scale; if you anticipate multi-tenanted long-context workloads, we should re-run with reserve factor.
- Token counting: we used BPE-like tokenization (similar to open models) — we included a small tab in the spreadsheet to paste a few canonical prompts for per-prompt delta.

I'll attach redwood-token-econ-sim-v1.xlsx with scenario tabs and a one-page summary. Priya — can you confirm the baseline hosted price proxy we should show to CardioNova legal? I proposed the $/1K numbers above for the first pass.

Karthik

Quick update on pricing proxies and MAP gating criteria we should propose: 

- Pricing proxy for POC (translucent to legal): hosted inference list priced at $0.00095 / 1K tokens baseline (matches Karthik sim). Show a dedicated discount line at 60% of hosted price for forecasted committed throughput.

- MAP gating acceptance criteria (proposed, to include in MAP-draft):
  * Performance gate: average generation latency p95 <= 280ms (under production-like load, warm-cache).
  * Cost gate: tokens per $ under baseline scenario >= 1.0M tokens/$ (fail if below 0.8M).
  * Quality gate: automated eval A/B vs internal reference prompts (BLEU/ROUGE-ish or human sample) — tie regression alerts to MAP fail conditions.
  * Ops gate: KV cache hit >= 30% on at least one major route OR prefetch path enabled.

- Timeline: we can deliver the spreadsheet + MAP addendum by Thu EOD PT; recommend a Friday readout with CardioNova ML infra + finance to confirm budget guardrails. Legal/Procurement can start redlines in parallel once the MAP acceptance criteria are agreed.
